research_question: Can an information-junction model inspired by p-n semiconductor dynamics reduce SAT solution latency without hiding exponential cost in time, energy, precision, communication, memory, preprocessing, or parallel work?
claim_boundary: No result in this repository proves P=NP, polynomial worst-case scaling, physical equivalence between semiconductor p-n junctions and complexity classes P/NP, or superiority over state-of-the-art SAT solvers.

prior_article.title: Project JANUS v7.2: How I Built a Self-Learning SAT-Solver That Breaks Its Own Records (And Why P=NP Is No Longer a Philosophy)
inherited_mechanisms: EXPLORE / EXPLOIT / HUNT / SURVIVE / CHAOS controller modes

experiments.headline: At 3-SAT n=48, median solved steps were 128 for WalkSAT and 36.5 for Junction; both solved 8/8.
At 3-SAT n=64, medians were 155 WalkSAT, 55 Junction Base, and 42 Junction Tunnel.
experiments.negative_result: At 3-SAT n=32, tunneling regressed median steps from 38 to 48 because escape activation was too aggressive.

experiments.headline: Adaptive depth removed most false breakdowns and reduced aggregate 3-SAT median transitions, but one hard n=64 instance exposed excessive uphill acceptance and avalanche probing.
experiments.retained_as: untouched LEGACY_V03 control lane inside v2.0

instances.3sat: 64 planted random instances near alpha 4.26; n=32,48,64,96,128,160,192,240; 8 trials per size
instances.5sat: 24 planted random instances near alpha 6.1; n=64,96,128; 8 trials per size

roles.GLADIUS_SELECTIVE: weakened oscillation, persistent charge, double-gated tested avalanche
roles.LEGACY_V03: untouched shadow/control lane with matched initial RNG state
roles.SCOUT: bounded CHAOS fallback; not activated in holdout
roles.HOLOCRON: coordinator, verifier and future physical display/witness

no_recombination_states.PROVEN_NO_RECOMBINATION: sound only when a complete sign-core witness is present
no_recombination_states.SEARCH_EXHAUSTED_NO_PROOF: budget exhausted without a sound UNSAT witness; never promoted to proof

experiments.interpretation: v2.0 lowers first-solution latency through a selectively activated distributed portfolio while openly paying approximately 2.11x aggregate work. It is not a single-node complexity improvement.

experiments.seed_policy: freeze hard-family seeds before outcome inspection
instances: Tseitin/parity-style CNF after independent generator validation
exactness_rules: heuristic score may reorder but may not delete live exact branches
experiments.claim_boundary: Transient-state geometry shared with regeneration research is a hypothesis-generation analogy only. Finite slopes or speedups do not prove polynomial worst-case behavior or P=NP.

role_map.Holocron: LEGACY_V03 plus coordinator and independent verifier

physical_target.protocol_rule: Do not modify existing Buzz J/B, share S/2, Janus J/T, or observer P/N ABIs. Add a separate versioned J/P v2 SAT experiment packet family.
physical_target.telemetry_rule: Report elapsed latency, total work, memory reconstruction, probe flips, packet count, packet loss, energy and stale-node events separately.
